original_test_intent: Measure NVLink bandwidth on every required HGX fabric edge with the approved NVQual Test #9 workload and prove the defined traffic directions meet per-link and aggregate thresholds without hang, reboot, topology degradation, errors, or unsafe thermal/power behavior.
original_method: Pin the GPU/link graph, Test #9 configuration, direction matrix, buffer/payload/concurrency, warmup, measurement duration/repetitions, raw byte/time or counter semantics, aggregation and thresholds; preserve baselines; run on an otherwise idle SUT with synchronized per-link counters, topology, error, thermal and power data; stop on first limit or instability and cool down without resetting links.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE provides the licensed workload, graph and thresholds; an operator reserves the HGX SUT, approves thermal/power limits and supervises abort/cooldown and recovery.
required_inputs: Licensed pinned NVQual Test #9 bandwidth configuration and compatible stack
GPU UUID/serial/slot and per-link port/topology map
Traffic direction, buffers/payload, concurrency, warmup, sample duration/repetitions and competing-load policy
Raw measurement/counter semantics, aggregation, bandwidth limits/tolerance, thermal/power limits, aborts and recovery
safety_requirements: Reserved non-production HGX SUT with no unrelated GPU workloads
Trusted authenticated access; stable cooling/power and independent monitoring
Preserve baselines/logs and complete outputs without truncation
Stop on bandwidth/link error, missing counter/link, topology change, thermal/power limit, fabric/GPU/host fault, hang/reboot or evidence gap
No link reset, load extension, evidence clearing or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate Test #9 recipe, graph, workload, measurement formula, thresholds, collectors and interlocks
Retain raw per-link counters/bytes/timing before calculating bandwidth
Correlate performance with topology, errors, GPU/fabric-manager, thermal, power, OS and BMC health
Do not infer limits, co-run workloads, reset links, retry faults or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Test #9 workload, graph, direction/workload/sampling plan and thresholds
Define aggregation, per-link/aggregate bandwidth, error and thermal/power acceptance
Own first-fault disposition, cooldown and recovery
Review raw samples/calculations and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH REPRODUCIBLE PER-LINK NVLINK BANDWIDTH QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Measure every approved traffic direction on an identity-bound fabric graph using pinned workload parameters, retain raw samples and report per-link distribution/aggregate with synchronized health telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds quantitative workload/measurement, per-link graph mapping, repeatability, complete secure artifacts, thermal/power interlocks and cooldown/recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A counter snapshot or vendor pass line cannot prove sustained per-link bandwidth, all directions, threshold margin, topology stability or absence of throttling.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Heavy NVLink traffic can raise GPU power/temperature and disturb other workloads; counter semantics and topology labels vary by stack version.

project_override_considerations: Vendor aggregate PASS is acceptable only when its pinned artifact exposes link coverage, directions, workload, raw samples or auditable measurement and thresholds. The enumeration-only use of Test #9 does not substitute for bandwidth coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #9 bandwidth manifest/license/version and authorization
Raw complete pre/during/post per-link counters or byte/time samples, calculations, distributions and threshold comparison
NVQual output, topology, fabric/GPU/link errors, thermal/power/utilization and timestamps
OS/BMC logs, abort/cooldown/recovery or clean final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Test #9 Procedure, Criteria and same-row AI review consistently target NVLink bandwidth. Missing quantitative workload and thresholds are readiness under-specification, not a competing objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The bandwidth objective is clear. Licensed tooling, graph, workload, measurement/threshold contract and monitoring are identifiable prerequisites rather than permanent review blockers.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2136 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00013-V002: approve the pinned NVQual Test #9 bandwidth configuration, GPU UUID/serial/slot and per-link topology, traffic direction matrix, buffers/payload/concurrency/warmup/duration/repetitions, raw counter/byte-time semantics, aggregation and per-link/aggregate thresholds, thermal/power aborts, cooldown and recovery.

review_improvement: Makes bandwidth independently reproducible per link and removes insecure/truncated counter evidence, co-load ambiguity and reset-to-pass behavior.
independent_technical_reasoning: Bandwidth is a time-bounded transfer measurement, not a link-state query. Direction, payload, concurrency, warmup, topology and thermal/power state determine the observed value. Raw counter or byte/time inputs must be bound to stable GPU/link identities so aggregates cannot hide a weak edge; the first shortfall must be preserved before another run changes temperature or counters.
